options: Hi all,
Dear colleagues!!!
Hello, dear colleagues!
why: В английском обращение заканчивается запятой, восклицательный знак — русская привычка. Для команды — «Hi all,» или «Hi everyone,».

options: Best regards, Ivan
Respectfully yours, Ivan
With big respect, Ivan
why: «With respect» — калька «С уважением». Стандарт — «Best regards» или «Kind regards».

bad: I am writing to you with the purpose to ask about the delivery.
options: I'm writing to ask about the delivery.
I write you for asking about the delivery.
The purpose of my letter is asking about the delivery.

bad: Give me please the drawings of the bracket.
options: Could you send me the drawings of the bracket, please?
Give me the drawings of the bracket, please!
You must give me the drawings of the bracket.
why: Повелительное наклонение звучит как приказ даже с please. Просьба — это вопрос.

bad: It is necessary to send the report.
options: Could you send the report by Friday?
It is needed to send the report.
The report must be sent.
why: Безличное «необходимо» — русский канцелярит. Скажи прямо, кто и что должен сделать.

options: I hope you don't mind me reaching out.
Sorry for disturbing you very much.
Excuse me for my disturbing.
why: Извиняться за само письмо не нужно. Если хочется смягчить — «I hope you don't mind me reaching out».

bad: I am interested in the vacancy of engineer.
options: I'm interested in the Design Engineer position.
I am interested in the vacancy of the engineer.
I have interest to the engineer vacancy.
why: «Vacancy of engineer» — калька. Позиция называется «the … position» с точным названием.

bad: I have big experience in CAD.
options: I have solid experience with CAD, mainly SolidWorks.
I have a big experience in CAD.
My experience in CAD is big.
why: Experience не бывает big. Говори «solid / hands-on experience with…» и уточняй.

bad: Thank you for the interview, it was very pleasant for me.
options: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today — I really enjoyed our conversation.
Thank you for the interview, it was very pleasant to me.
The interview was pleasant for me, thank you.
why: «Pleasant for me» — калька. «I really enjoyed…» звучит естественно.

bad: Can you send me the report until Friday?
options: Could you send me the report by Friday?
Can you send me the report till Friday?
Can you send me the report before Friday until?
why: Срок — by («не позже»). Until — «пока длится»: «I'll be in the lab until Friday».

bad: I didn't receive any answer from you.
options: Just checking in — have you had a chance to look at my question?
I didn't get any answer from you yet!
Why didn't you answer?
why: Звучит как обвинение. Follow-up — мягкий: «Just checking in…».

bad: I have a question to you.
options: I have a question for you.
I have a question at you.
I have to you a question.

bad: I propose you to meet on Monday.
options: How about meeting on Monday?
I propose you meeting on Monday.
I offer you to meet on Monday.
why: После propose/suggest не бывает «you to». Проще: «How about…?» или «I suggest meeting…».

context: Отказ на просьбу срочно провести испытание
options: Unfortunately, that won't be possible this week, but we could run it on Tuesday.
It is absolutely impossible.
Impossible, sorry.
why: Голое «impossible» звучит резко. Смягчи «unfortunately» и предложи альтернативу.

bad: Sorry, sorry, I can't come, I'm so sorry.
options: Sorry for the short notice — could we move our meeting to Thursday?
Sorry, sorry, I can't come.
I am very very sorry that I can't come.
why: Одно извинение и сразу предложение. Много «sorry» звучит неуверенно.

options: We ran the test yesterday.
We did make the test yesterday.
We have made the test yesterday.
why: Испытания проводят (run / carry out / do), а не make. И с yesterday — Past Simple.

options: The deadline is very close.
The deadline is on fire.
The deadline burns.
why: «Горит» — русская метафора. По-английски: «very close», «tight», «we're running out of time».

bad: The results will be sent to you additionally.
options: I'll send you the results separately.
The results will be additionally sent.
Additionally I will send you results additionally.
